SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.sum_prices, o.create_time, o.shipping_fee, o.payment_method, o.payment_time, o.remark,
-- 地址信息 a.name, a.phone, a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address,
-- 商品详情 od.fresh_id, f.fresh_name, f.picture_address, od.count, f.prices AS original_price, CASE WHEN f.promotion_price > 0 AND f.promotion_price < f.prices THEN f.promotion_price ELSE f.prices END AS actual_price
FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN address a ON o.address_id = a.id LEFT JOIN order_detail od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN fresh f ON od.fresh_id = f.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.is_deleted = 0
AND (o.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR f.fresh_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.status = '待发货' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.sum_prices, o.create_time, o.shipping_fee, o.payment_method, o.payment_time, o.remark, a.name, a.phone, a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address, od.fresh_id, f.fresh_name, f.picture_address, od.count, f.prices AS original_price, CASE WHEN f.promotion_price > 0 AND f.promotion_price < f.prices THEN f.promotion_price ELSE f.prices END AS actual_price FROM ( SELECT order_id FROM `order` main_order
main_order.is_deleted = 0
AND main_order.status = #{status}
AND (main_order.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM address sub_addr WHERE sub_addr.id = main_order.address_id AND sub_addr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') ))
ORDER BY main_order.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset} ) AS main INNER JOIN `order` o ON main.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN address a ON o.address_id = a.id LEFT JOIN order_detail od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN fresh f ON od.fresh_id = f.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.status = '待发货' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT main_order.order_id) FROM `order` main_order
main_order.is_deleted = 0
AND main_order.status = #{status}
AND (main_order.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM address sub_addr WHERE sub_addr.id = main_order.address_id AND sub_addr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') ))

SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.sum_prices, o.create_time, o.shipping_fee, o.payment_method, o.payment_time, o.remark, a.name, a.phone, a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address, od.fresh_id, f.fresh_name, f.picture_address, od.count, f.prices AS original_price, CASE WHEN f.promotion_price > 0 AND f.promotion_price < f.prices THEN f.promotion_price ELSE f.prices END AS actual_price FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN address a ON o.address_id = a.id LEFT JOIN order_detail od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN fresh f ON od.fresh_id = f.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.order_number = #{orderNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_number AS orderNumber, status, user_id AS userId, address_id AS addressId, sum_prices AS sumPrices, shipping_fee AS shippingFee, payment_method AS paymentMethod, payment_time AS paymentTime, create_time AS createTime, version FROM `order` WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber} AND is_deleted = 0
